Pricing.title: Simple, usage-based pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes all models. Cancel anytime.
Pricing.explainerTitle: What's the difference between monthly and add-on credits?
Pricing.explainerMonthly: Monthly credits reset with every billing cycle — whatever you don't use does not roll over.
Pricing.explainerAddon: Add-on credits are a one-time purchase, never expire, and stay yours even after you cancel.
Pricing.explainerOrder: Generating spends monthly credits first; add-on credits are only touched once the monthly ones run out — so they are never wiped at the end of the month.
Pricing.sameFeatures: All models, all features. Plans differ only in monthly credits.
Pricing.plansUnavailable: Plans can't be loaded right now. Please try again in a moment.
Pricing.addonsComingSoon: Add-on packs are not on sale yet. When they launch they will be a one-time purchase that never expires, on top of your monthly credits.

AdminSettings.title: Admin Settings
AdminSettings.subtitle: Configure upstream API keys, R2 storage, and the app base URL.
AdminSettings.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear this secret? This cannot be undone without re-entering the value.
AdminSettings.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this page.
AdminSettings.stripeNote: Note: Stripe secrets (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) are not managed here — they are set as environment variables on the server and cannot be changed from the UI.
AdminSettings.ezlinkaiBaseUrlHelp: The base URL of the upstream EzLinkAI / Flux API.
AdminSettings.fluxApiKeyHelp: API key for the upstream image generation service.
AdminSettings.r2EndpointHelp: The S3-compatible endpoint for your Cloudflare R2 bucket.
AdminSettings.r2BucketHelp: The name of the R2 bucket where images are stored.
AdminSettings.r2PublicBaseUrlHelp: The public base URL used to serve images from R2.
AdminSettings.appBaseUrlHelp: The canonical base URL of this application.
AdminSettings.signupBonusCreditsHelp: Monthly credits granted automatically to every new account. 0 or empty disables it. Granted as monthly credits, so a paid subscription's first invoice replaces them. Before turning this on, make sure the reverse proxy has rate limiting on the signup endpoint — signup has no email verification or captcha, so a bonus turns account-farming into something that costs you real upstream money.

AdminPlans.title: Plans
AdminPlans.subtitle: Monthly credits per tier. Price and Stripe Price ID cannot be changed here.
AdminPlans.immutableNote: Price and Stripe Price ID are immutable: a Stripe Price amount cannot be changed after creation. To change pricing, create a new Price and point the plan at it.

AdminPlans.numberRequired: Enter a number. Leaving this blank would save it as 0.

AdminModels.title: Models
AdminModels.subtitle: Credits charged per generation, and which models are available.
AdminModels.immutableNote: Provider and upstream model are immutable: generations reference a model by id, so repointing it would mix two different result sets under one name in reconciliation. To switch upstream, create a new model and retire the old one.
AdminModels.creditsHelp: Must be at least 1. The billing path rejects a cost of 0, so a model with 0 credits fails every generation.
AdminModels.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
AdminModels.numberRequired: Enter a number. Leaving this blank would save it as 0.
